committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Directly involves federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial agencies, as well as private agricultural stakeholders participating in the exercise.
dimensions.evidence: include coordination with appropriate Federal departments and agencies; State, local, Tribal, and territorial agencies; private sector owners and operators

dimensions.assessment: Conducts a planning and response exercise rather than creating permanent operational law enforcement changes.
dimensions.evidence: conduct an exercise related to the prevention, response to, recovery from, and mitigation of an act of agroterrorism

dimensions.assessment: No specific appropriations or funding amounts are stated in the source text.
Requires a specific DHS exercise and a subsequent report to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee on Homeland Security of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs of the Senate an after-action report

dimensions.assessment: One-time exercise requirement with a deadline four years post-enactment and a follow-up report.
dimensions.evidence: not later than four years after the date of the enactment of this section, conduct an exercise

missing_information: The source does not provide the financial cost of conducting the exercise.
importance_detail.rationale: Mandates a single federal interagency exercise on agroterrorism by the Department of Homeland Security and an after-action report to Congress, representing an administrative preparedness action.
